title: Soften Overhead Shadows in an iPhone Selfie
description: Use white screen fill near eye level to soften shadows from a ceiling light. Try a small adjustment in the preview and check the saved iPhone selfie.
direct: When a ceiling lamp casts shadows under your eyes, move out from directly beneath it and try a small amount of white screen fill at eye level.
figureAlt: Photorealistic side angle of a person seated at a dressing table holding an iPhone near eye level, a ceiling pendant has a warm pool of light slightly behind the person, faint cool white fill from the phone
figureCaption: AI illustration of the position of the lights.
cards.decision.heading: Move the light or move yourself
cards.decision.body: A lamp above your head can light your forehead while your brow shades your eyes. Step slightly away from directly beneath the lamp. Keep the phone about eye level, then look at your face in the live preview.
sections.detail-1.heading: Compare at the same distance
sections.detail-1.body: Try one test with the screen light low and one with it slightly higher. Keep your position and framing the same. Inspect the saved photos at the same display brightness.
sections.detail-2.heading: About the app
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone app. Check the App Store listing for current access and export options.
faqs.first-question.heading: Will the effect be the same in every room?
faqs.first-question.body: The phone’s distance and the amount of other light matter. Adjust the setup for the room you are in.
faqs.second-question.heading: Does this remove shadows from an existing photo?
faqs.second-question.body: This is a lighting setup for a new photo. Use the live view to check it before capturing.

steps.step-1.text: Open GlowPop: Selfie Glow Camera in the front camera view. Choose a white screen light and start with low brightness.
steps.step-2.text: Keep the distance steady while raising the screen brightness a little. Check whether you can see the eyes clearly without losing the highlights on the forehead.
steps.step-3.text: Take a test photo and check the saved copy. If the ceiling light still dominates, try a different position or turn it off if the room has enough other light.
